facts.fact: ARSEL's 2025 annual report, as quoted by EcoMatin, puts the average at 64.04 interruptions per customer in 2025 (53.30 in 2024), which is 5.34 a month.
The 24 July 2026 validation minutes give 59.42 interruptions per customer in 2025 by the regulator ARSEL's reckoning, which is 4.95 a month.
The same minutes give 15.09 interruptions per customer in 2025 by the operator Socadel's reckoning, which is 1.26 a month; the parties did not agree.
